title: Fan Fiction
author: Prime Video x Konbini
description: What happens when two comedians find insanely incredible Fan Fiction anonymously posted online? They ask their friends to perform it as seriously as possible. On each episode of Fan Fiction, Alyssa Davis, Reilly Willson, and one hilarious guest perform dramatic readings of real fan fiction from deep corners of the internet and try to figure out what in the world is going on.
